name: Summer Volunteer Program at Fort Washington Medical Center
org: Adventist HealthCare Fort Washington Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer in the summer at a hospital in Prince George's County. Volunteers help in many areas of the hospital.
who_can_apply: Volunteers ages 15 and older. The page lists no residency rule.
duration: Summer. In 2026: pre-registration in spring, a meet and greet in May, and orientation in June.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 pre-registration ran March 9 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Pre-register on the hospital's volunteer page when it opens. Then you may have a meet and greet, a 4 hour orientation, a meeting with your department leader, and a background check. Bring shot records (MMR, chickenpox, Tdap, Hep B, flu, and COVID-19).
notes: The page still says pre-registration is open, but its dates are from spring 2026. Adventist HealthCare main line: 301-315-3030.
